challenge: Influencer marketing often relies on intuition rather than data. Content creators struggle to identify which content formats, posting schedules, and platform features actually drive growth versus which just feel productive. The challenge was creating a comprehensive growth strategy grounded in analytics that could be presented as a compelling pitch to stakeholders.
approach: Built a data-driven growth framework analyzing audience demographics, engagement patterns, and content performance across platforms. The strategy deck translated complex analytics into actionable recommendations — specific content types to prioritize, optimal posting windows, audience segments to target, and growth milestones with clear timelines. Visual design of the pitch deck itself was crafted to demonstrate the creative quality the strategy would deliver.
result: The growth strategy provided a clear, measurable roadmap from current audience size to target milestones. The data-backed approach replaced gut-feel content decisions with evidence-based optimization. The pitch deck format made the strategy communicable to non-marketing stakeholders who needed to approve budgets and resources.
